objective.primary: top1 scheduled-day mean net open-to-close return in percentage points
objective.unfilled_policy: rank first; an unfilled slot receives zero return and zero cost; never substitute a lower rank after observing execution

fixed_estimator_family.penalty: L2, expressed explicitly as l1_ratio=0.0 for the pinned scikit-learn runtime
fixed_estimator_family.preprocessing: training-only median imputation with missing indicators, then training-only standard scaling

sealed_holdout.source: official JPX daily stock quotation PDFs
sealed_holdout.rule: do not compute or inspect holdout returns until the development winner, implementation hashes, and data hashes are frozen
sealed_holdout.parse_policy: the holdout phase re-hashes every raw PDF, writes an exclusive consumed receipt, and only then parses all PDFs directly; no pre-parsed holdout input is accepted
sealed_holdout.excluded_contamination: 2025-08-01 was opened only to inspect a previously unsupported JPX PDF layout before model selection; it is excluded from every scored holdout metric and label and is retained solely as the completed prior-session feature source for 2025-08-04

feature_blocks.legacy_v03: 18-column v0.3 estimator-and-feature control (price-12 plus TDnet-clear-6), re-evaluated under the corrected common calendar, source-completeness, and corporate-action hygiene
feature_blocks.bounded_daily: 16 features: cross-sectional ranks of prior open-to-close, overnight, volatility, 5/20/60-session close momentum and 20-session close location, plus four fixed ATR-scaled nonlinear transforms; all use completed prior sessions only
feature_blocks.session_shape: 34 features: bounded_daily plus prior AM/PM returns, ranges, midday gap, PM close location, rolling PM behaviour, and fixed PM shock hinges
feature_blocks.session_market: 39 features: session_shape plus prior equal-weight market return, rolling stock beta, and beta/ATR market-regime interactions
feature_blocks.session_tdnet: 56 features: session_shape plus pre-open-known TDnet count/timing, generic title-derived material categories, and revision/financing-by-prior-run-up interactions
feature_blocks.session_market_tdnet: 62 features: session_market plus the same TDnet block and a TDnet-presence-by-market-regime interaction

prospective_only_features.futures_context: Nikkei 225 and TOPIX futures returns observed no later than 08:58:59 JST
prospective_only_features.historical_selection_status: excluded because exact point-in-time futures snapshots are unavailable locally; no later daily value may be substituted

model_objectives.net_positive_magnitude_weighted: net_positive_20bp with abs(return - 0.20) clipped to 0.25..3.00 and weights renormalized to equal total weight per date
model_objectives.same_day_top_quintile: 1(return is in the top 20 percent of training-eligible securities on its date)

weighting.all_candidates: every training session has total sample weight 1
weighting.balanced_candidates: two-margin raking preserves the per-session total of 1 and makes the two class totals equal; the positive-class multiplier is solved by deterministic bisection and infeasible margins are fatal
weighting.legacy_v03_control: the original sklearn estimator class_weight=balanced multiplied by 1/n securities per date; this is an estimator-and-feature control under corrected shared data hygiene, not a claim of byte-for-byte historical prediction parity

missing_day_policy.scheduled_days: every exchange session in each evaluation interval is present in the return series
missing_day_policy.no_candidate_or_source_incomplete: emit empty rank slots with zero return, zero cost, and display=false; never drop or substitute the day
missing_day_policy.tdnet: calendar-day collection completeness from the preceding exchange session through the target cutoff is required; incomplete dates are ineligible for every candidate block
missing_day_policy.coverage_gate: candidate display rate below 95 percent fails validation

corporate_action_hygiene: a security is ineligible when any completed prior session in the last 60 sessions has an absolute raw overnight move above 30 percent; this is a point-in-time discontinuity heuristic, not complete corporate-action adjustment, so smaller-ratio actions or actions hidden by missing source rows remain a shadow-only limitation

staged_search.stage_1: screen every one of the 24 feature-block x objective pairs on feature_screen with C=0.08, balanced classes, expanding history and quarterly walk-forward; retain the best objective within each of all six blocks by block-5 one-sided 90% lower bound, then mean, then fewer features, then id
staged_search.stage_2: on model_design compare the six retained block/objective pairs with C=0.08, balanced classes, expanding history and quarterly walk-forward; retain three pairs by the same ordering
staged_search.stage_4: evaluate the three finalists on development_confirmation with monthly retraining; select the highest block-5 lower bound among development-gate passers, otherwise the highest lower bound and mark no_edge
staged_search.stage_5: freeze the winner and implementation/data hashes, then evaluate the winner and the v0.3 estimator-and-feature control once on sealed_holdout with monthly retraining

multiple_testing_diagnostic: report a shared five-session moving-block White-style reality-check p-value across the three development finalists; do not use it to reopen or expand the candidate registry

stopping_rule.all_holdout_gates_pass: validated-shadow; feature and model design are frozen
stopping_rule.positive_holdout_mean_but_any_gate_fails: provisional-shadow; freeze without holdout retuning and collect 60-100 new sessions
stopping_rule.nonpositive_holdout_mean: no demonstrated tradable edge; retain the frozen specification as research baseline only
